parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a sample-app directory that is a canonical restraint marker per the decision rules. Although 'is_sample_app' is flagged false, the file path unambiguously places this initializer inside a sample/demo target. Extracting 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init' to a shared location would couple the production 'DebugPanel' package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication here is intentional: the WallpaperSampleApp's DebugHUD replicates the display-link machinery locally so the sample app remains self-contained.
